text:
Ivy Zhao: opened PR #678 to consolidate the pricing -> quotas -> dashboards doc flow. Main goals: add a migration snippet for header name changes, swap the demo dashboard panel to use the canonical metric, and add an SDK helper example for reading remaining quota. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678
Liam O'Connor: nice. which canonical metric are we standardizing on now? I saw `quota_consumed_total` and `rw_quota_consumed_total` in different places.
Ivy Zhao: opting for `rw_quota_consumed_total` (namespaced). PR includes an exported Grafana panel JSON that references the metric and a note about the metric rename.
Harpreet Kaur: can you add a short note in the billing page about the difference between "token allowance" and "metered usage"? PMs asked for that language.
Ivy Zhao: added a one-liner: "Monthly quota = token allowance per pricing tier; metered usage = tokens consumed and reported by rw_quota_consumed_total." Kept it short.
Mateo Rivera: on SDK snippets  I added Python, TS, and a Rust example (for platform teams). Python uses `.headers.get` with fallback for old names. snippet:
```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
remaining = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Remaining') or resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining')
limit = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-Limit') or resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Limit')
print(f"{remaining}/{limit} tokens")
```
Mateo Rivera: TS example mirrors that with `resp.headers.get(...) || resp.headers.get(...)`. Rust snippet uses `reqwest` header lookup.
Liam O'Connor: small nit: our internal header access helper lowercases keys, so note in the doc that header names are case-insensitive but show canonical casing.
Ivy Zhao: good catch  updated doc sentence to say "headers are case-insensitive; examples show canonical casing".
Harpreet Kaur: dashboard image in the pricing page is slightly out of date  legend still lists `quota_used_total`. Mateo can you replace screenshot with the new panel showing `rw_quota_consumed_total`?
Mateo Rivera: pushed hi-res screenshot under `/assets/images/quota-panel-v2.png` and updated the markdown to reference it. Also updated the panel JSON to use `$team` dashboard variable instead of `$org`.
DocsBot: PR #678 status changed: reviewers requested @liam, @harpreet, @mateo.
Liam O'Connor: reviewed and left two tiny suggestions: add a footnote mapping old->new metric names, and clarify the deprecation window (14 days).
Harpreet Kaur: approved after wording tweak on the token allowance sentence.
Mateo Rivera: approved (image and panel JSON look good).
Ivy Zhao: merged after CI passed. I'll post a short note in #docs and ping infra to update the exporter docs so alerting rules don't break.
DocsBot: PR #678 merged by Ivy Zhao.
